'''2007 Dagobah Regionals Nick Culpepper DS Cloud City: Upper Walkway''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Culpepper]] at [[2007 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: Upper Walkway|SE-D-cloudcityupperwalkway.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Clouds? You've Gotta Be Kiddin' Me
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
